lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: The ground stopped descending... Is this the bottom of the labyrinth?
You wander aimlessly in the dark, believing you have found an end.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Crows?! Who's there? Step out from the shadows!

lines.speaker: Itachi
lines.text: I am Itachi Uchiha. You have fought well to reach these depths, but your reality ends here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: I defeated Naruto, and I survived this maze. I won't let your mind games stop me now!

lines.speaker: Itachi
lines.text: Bravery without vision is merely foolishness. Step into Tsukuyomi... and face yourself.
